Author: Johnneylee Jack Rollins
Name: Almanac
Punchline: Talk to a local AI model in game, with XivMcp's tools.
Description: Connects a model running on your own PC (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp or any OpenAI-compatible server) to the game through XivMcp. Setup wizard with GPU-aware model recommendations, an in-game chat with threads and streaming, and a benchmark you can share with the community leaderboard. No cloud, no Python. Requires the XivMcp plugin for game tools.
